follow-up time: Until serum β-HCG returned to normal and subsequent pregnancies
outcome: Volume of blood loss during curettage
cohort: 53 patients with CSP who were pretreated with MTX and UAE prior to curettage at a single institute from January 2013 to December 2015
finding: Pretreatment with methotrexate and uterine artery embolization prior to curettage appears to be a safe and effective management strategy for cesarean scar pregnancy with encouraging reproductive outcomes.
